name: web-fatis-designer-lanyard-badges-and-thanks-for-watching
title: Fati's closing slide: illustrated designer lanyard badges and a pink handwritten 'Thanks For Watching'
whatItIs: A hot pink frame holding two panels: a photo of two ID badges on lanyards (white and pink) with illustrated portraits of hijab-wearing product designers, role tags and slogans, and a beige panel with a large pink handwritten 'Thanks For Watching'.
whatItMeans: Personal and memorable; credits as conference badges put faces to the work.
techniques: Present credits as lanyard ID badges.
Use illustrated avatars instead of photos.
Close with a big handwritten thank-you.

vocabulary.definition: A slide naming the people behind a project.
An ID card worn on a neck strap.
